description: List what blocks a ticket, or with direction "blocks", what it blocks. Resolved blockers are included with resolved_at set. The ids here are what resolve_blocker takes.

direction.description: blocked_by (default): what this ticket waits on. blocks: what waits on it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: list_blockers
title: List a ticket's blockers
